column1: # The font store's language-pack downloader (craft-font-store, ureq with rustls; gate `font-download`).
# Read Aloud's Speech Dispatcher client (gate `ssip`): its wire framing crate. The client itself is std::net
# code in the engine, which cargo tree cannot see; the gate test (crates/engine/tests/katwork_profile.rs) checks it.
# The web build: the downloader and the Speech Dispatcher client are native only, so these rows are vacuous. The
# web interface's font picker keeps craft's font manager, which holds the store's built-in index (craft-font-store).
# Each gated library crate defaults its gates on too (an upstream build of the crate alone is unchanged).
# Each app forwards its gates to the crates it builds: a stray default would turn a gate back on there.
